[CNBC]
หัวข้อ: Trump says Karoline Leavitt resigning as White House press secretary
เนื้อหา: Leavitt, the youngest White House press secretary ever, gave birth in May to a girl, her second child.

หัวข้อ: Cisco sees record results from an AI ‘supercycle,’ but its stock pulls back
